messages.content:
Two readers answered the same question about machines at work. Reader A used facts taken from a fact
store; each fact comes with the sentence it was taken from. Reader B read the documents directly and points at
sentences. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When the two rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- If reader B found nothing, decide only whether A's evidence really states A's answer for the exact subject.
- "same" means the two answers say the same thing. "neither" means neither answer is supported.
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": "A" | "B" | "same" | "neither"}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which categories of machinery always require a conformity assessment procedure involving a notified body?

Answer A: ["removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards", "vehicle servicing lifts", "Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery", "safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour", "machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions"]
Under Article 25(2) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, the categories listed in Annex I, Part A always require a notified body, through module G, module H, or module B followed by module C. These are the removable transmission devices, vehicle servicing lifts, cartridge-operated fixing machinery, self-evolving safety components, and ML-based safety systems.
Evidence of A:
- machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A: requiresProcedure = specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) | sentence: "Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)." [REG, Art. 6(1)]
- categories of machinery or related products: requiresProcedure = procedure referred to in Article 25(2) | sentence: "PART A Categories of machinery or related products to which a procedure referred to in Article 25(2) shall be applied:" [REG, Annex I, Part A]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X." [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX;" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII;" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- manufacturer: hasObligation = shall apply one of the following procedures (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures:" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions: listedIn = 6. (condition: in respect only of those systems) | sentence: "6. Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]
- Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery: listedIn = 4. | sentence: "4. Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 4]
- removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards: listedIn = 1. | sentence: "1. Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 1]
- vehicle servicing lifts: listedIn = Vehicle servicing lifts | sentence: "3. Vehicle servicing lifts." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
- safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour: listedIn = Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour | sentence: "Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5]

Answer B: ["Annex I, Part A, point 4: portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery", "Annex I, Part A, point 6: machinery with embedded self-evolving machine-learning systems ensuring safety functions (in respect only of those systems)"]
Under Article 6(1) and Article 25(2) of the Machinery Regulation, the categories in Annex I, Part A always require one of the procedures involving a notified body (module B with C, module H, or module G). The passages cite only points 4 and 6 of Part A, so the full list is not confirmed here.
Evidence of B:
- Read on demand: REG, Art. 25(2) | sentence: "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures:" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- Read on demand: REG, Annex I, Part A, point 4 | sentence: "4. Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 4]
- Read on demand: REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6 | sentence: "6. Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]

response.text: {"reasoning": "Reader A's evidence states, for each of its five items, that it is listed in Annex I, Part A, and Article 25(2) requires a module G, H, or B+C procedure for Part A categories. Reader B covers only two of the items and says the full list is not confirmed. A's list is not verified as complete, but it is far better supported than B's partial list.", "choice": "A"}
